figures.finding: Portuguese is the official language of Angola by the constitution, which also has the State promote the other Angolan languages; no source names the language of screen work as such.

value.basis: constitution, not a statement on film

sources.said: The official language of the Republic of Angola is Portuguese.

figures.finding: Luanda is the capital by the constitution; no source measuring where screen work is made was found.

sources.said: The capital of the Republic of Angola is Luanda.

figures.finding: The only pay floor found for an employed performer in Angola is the national minimum wage: Presidential Decree 152/24 of 17 July 2024 set a general minimum of AOA 70,000 a month (AOA 50,000 for micro-enterprises and start-ups), to rise to AOA 100,000 in 2025, with 12 or 24 months for employers to reach it.

target.due: 2025 (12 months for employers already at 70,000; 24 months for those below)

value.law: Decreto Presidencial n.º 152/24, de 17 de Julho

figures.applies: Angola, any employee, a performer among them; no film, television or stage rate found; the 2025 step's own decree was not read.

sources.said: foi aprovada no mês seguinte, através do Decreto Presidencial n.º 152/24 de 17 de Julho, publicado em Diário da República. Assim, o Governo instituiu dois salários mínimos, um geral, de 70 mil Kz, que terá de ser actualizado para 100 mil Kz em 2025, e um de 50 mil Kz para as micro-empresas e startups. … Às empresas que já pagavam 70 mil Kz foram dados 12 meses para evoluir até aos 100 mil Kz.
